title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Palma de Mallorca | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from London to Palma de Mallorca in Spain on 22 April 1971.

This was the second of several trips to Mallorca in which Ono attempted to gain custody of her daughter Kyoko. Lennon and Ono had managed to locate the seven-year-old on the island on 20 April, where she was living with her father Tony Cox and his wife Melinda.
